notes.title: Roadmap Ahead: Part 2
notes.content:
Hey everyone, welcome back to the second part of our Roadmap series! In our last article, we talked about the structure of the co-op experience ([url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3265230/view/510717443482583605]Acts 1 and 2, Challenge and Endless Modes[/url], etc), now it's time for us to share what lurks inside those dungeons and beyond.

[h2]The Ruined Temple Dungeon[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253351/18f4fc06458d536f2469bc8e7f659e26ea7e9bd9.gif[/img]
What did the Dark Queen get up to? Looks like there’s more to her story than meets the eye. In Act 2, you face an all new environment. You and your squad will descend into a ruined temple where sandstone walls, deep caverns and sinister rituals tell you you're not welcome. Plus we mustn't forget to mention the scary inhabitants.

[h2]New Traps[/h2]
Monsters aren't your only problem. The Dungeon itself is out to kill you. Here are some new traps for the upcoming Early Access.

[b]The Crusher Trap: [/b]pulverizes anyone who dares step inside unless you say the right words, then it will stop momentarily, with just enough time for you to cross it. Run across before it restarts. You only have a short time until it starts again.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253351/0c0167439b8d0e4c698b98c8dcbfc94acc00e095.gif[/img]

[b]The floor is literally LAVA:[/b] exactly what it sounds like. Step wrong, and it's instant boiling death.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253351/e38996a4885157281df664476fb40567db269020.gif[/img]

[b]The Meathook:[/b] A swinging pendulum of death. Time your movements around it. Get it wrong and it will push you into the lava and you get cooked.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253351/55e8d3a3dde87cceb9bc9825f68f6a3e0bd37639.gif[/img]

[h2]New Abyssal Lands[/h2]
And beyond the dungeon walls? New lands for you to explore with more creatures that make going back more treacherous than ever. It would be wise to stock up on teleport stones and find more ways to get home.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253351/8cd6075a514db7b4135550c636623e9ce184ae52.png[/img]

This is just the beginning of what we're building to make every run unpredictable, deadly, and memorable. Part 3 of our Roadmap will take you even deeper, but for now… stay tuned my dear Companions.

Don't forget to join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/WpmWCmgZRz]Discord[/url] - we have special skins and other launch promos for our community.

[h3]And as always - FOLLOW AND WISHLIST![/h3]

notes.title: Roadmap Ahead: Part 1
notes.content:
Hey everyone, this is the first of a series of roadmap articles where we'll share our plans for the game and explain the direction we're taking for the game's march towards Early Access.

[h2]Different Playstyles[/h2]
In other co-op games we've watched and played, sessions with friends often range from 1 to 3 hours casually, and even longer for groups who really want to push their limits. 

Our early idea was for the game to progress endlessly as players got better. But that approach had drawbacks - especially for casual players who don't want to grind through the same early stages every time just to see the mid- or late-game. We also felt that runs needed a sense of closure, so players can feel they've completed something together.

We also know it's not always easy to get a crew together, so we've built modes that work for any kind of team. 

Whether you're jumping in with close friends or teaming up on the fly, there's a mode that works for you.

[h2]Game Modes for Casual and Hardcore players[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253351/76df7c6c6c1978d39bb87bad5cd4f66c98bf3e0c.png[/img]
The Co-op Game will have different game modes, giving both casual and hardcore players experiences that fit their playstyle.

[b]Chapter 1[/b] – A ‘gentle' starting point for casual players and beginners. There will be three in-game days, and if you pass, you get to fight the Chapter 1 Boss. If you enjoyed the demo, this will feel familiar.

[b]Chapter 2[/b] – A tougher challenge with a Ruined Temple dungeon, new Abyssal Lands, traps, items, and monsters, etc, ending with a Chapter 2 Boss battle.

[b]Challenge Mode[/b] – A longer, riskier adventure: six in-game Days, plus a Boss (either Chapter 1 or Chapter 2 boss), combining monsters, items and environments from both chapters.

[b]Endless Mode[/b] – No stopping point - keep going as long as you can. Every 6 days you can choose to face a Boss (either Chapter 1 or Chapter 2 boss). Try to get as far as you can. 

[b]Hard Difficulty[/b] – Available in Chapter 1, Chapter 2, and Challenge Mode for those who want to test themselves. [i]The Queen heartily approves...[/i]

[b]Rewards[/b] – Unlock unique Achievements and skins as proof of your progress.

[h2]Sneak Peek: The Ruined Temple[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253351/8dd8509e3444d1eb31d2e3f9b70ea7d4d8864eca.gif[/img]
Chapter Two gets an all new environment - the Ruined Temple. More monsters and creatures await in this second act of the Cursed Companions.

We'll cover more in the upcoming posts as we dive deeper into the new features we're developing towards Early Access.

The support from this community has blown us away - you've streamed, tested, and shared your feedback, and that fuels us every single day. With your help, we're making something truly special.

Don't forget to join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/WpmWCmgZRz]Discord[/url] - we have special skins and other launch promos for our community.

[h3]And as always - WISHLIST![/h3]

notes.title: Launch Date Update!
notes.content:
Thank you all so much for the incredible support - we've seen so many of you asking "[i]When is the game launching?[/i]" and we finally have an update to share.

We've been hard at work and now have a firm roadmap in place. We're excited to confirm that the game will launch in Q4 2025. 🗓️

That said, we aren't ready to pin down the exact date just yet. As many of you know, game development comes with moving parts and we want to be confident things are working well before making the announcement. We are a small team so we need to prioritize which parts of the game to focus on, in order to make the experience fun for our players.

Right now, our team is focused on building out some exciting new features - including [b]boss levels (!), fresh environments, special items and terrifying new monsters (did we mention more unlockable SKINS?)[/b]🤩. These will be highlighted in an upcoming roadmap post so you'll know what we have planned for our Early Access launch.

Once those pieces are fully locked in, we'll be able to announce the official launch date.

Thank you again for your patience, your enthusiasm, and your amazing support throughout this journey. We truly couldn’t do this without you - and we can't wait to share more very soon. 💜

And if you haven’t done so already, WISHLIST!

notes.title: Demo Update - Rebirth Egg, Speech Recognition tweaks and other improvements
notes.content:
We made some minor updates to the demo. One of the bigger changes we made to the mechanics was to add a Rebirth Egg. Many asked for ways to revive dead companions. The Rebirth Egg is one idea we've had but didn't really want to implement as it may make things easier for players. But we shall see. we're looking forward to seeing how players make use of this in the game. If it is popular, more respawn mechanics will be implemented.

[h2]Key Updates: [/h2]
[b]Update for 0.9.9[/b]
[i]For Public Demo, Build ID: 19679335[/i]

[b]Rebirth Egg:[/b] Respawns dead players when you say the magic spell. It will randomly choose a dead player to revive. Respawned players respawn at low health. Can be purchased in the Shop and in Gregory. Not available in Traitor Mode (for obvious reasons)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253351/2c9d6b1c12af124ae6896981d1a08a823d1f693a.png[/img]

[b]Proximity Chat QOL Updates[/b]: Proximity chat improved its re-connection detection to minimize dropouts when talking to friends.

[b]Speech Recognition QOL Updates[/b]: The game will reinitialize the speech recognition functionality if it detects audio hardware changes on Windows or further errors thrown up by the system. This should minimize issues where the game cannot detect the words players are saying.

[b]New Voice Calibration[/b]: To help players 'train' their speech, a short calibration page at the start let's players change their microphone setups and try the speech recognition before they start playing the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253351/4e9224986c7411b178de48f3acab81adbc35ee7b.png[/img]

[b]High Latency Warning[/b]: If your ping is high, the game will show a tiny warning message for a short while. We're working on optimizing the game so network issues like de-syncing are reduced. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253351/ec8f70dd246499f524934e9a9f6b3d94ed76556b.png[/img]


[h2]Known Bugs[/h2]
[list]
[*] Traitor Mode: If you revive a late joiner via the Dark Shrine, player has no role assigned in the game
[*] Late joiners - if they join a game midway - they are unable to hear other dead players (in spectate mode)
[*] Players can sometimes move when the portal open / close scene plays
[/list]

[h2]Coming up...[/h2]
We have big news coming up concerning the road ahead. We've been spending this time reading your feedback and watching your streams and furiously working on adding the content for the Early Access launch. Stay tuned. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253351/e389138c02a9c40b6846861e4cdfb899e580e94c.jpg[/img]
In the meantime, we've got a [b]SPEEDRUN competition[/b] going on in our Discord - https://discord.gg/cursedcompanions - do drop by! We have plans to grow the community, and reward them with contests, free skins and best of all - game keys!

And as always WISHLIST!

notes.title: Latest Demo Drop - Tweaks, Fixes, and More Chaos
notes.content:
Our Cursed Companions community has grown significantly since our last update, and we've got so much feedback and love and encouragement from them all. From the bottom of our hearts, we thank you.❤️ We're trying our best and working tirelessly to make improvements.

After hearing from you and watching streamer feeds, we found some of the pain points, fixed some bugs, made some improvements and tweaks to the game. 

Our team is small and we're trying to cover as much ground as we can, but we have to be strategic and work on those changes that can significantly improve the gameplay experience, so do forgive us if there are still bugs and things that still irk you. If there's something that can be improved, please try to reach out to us via Discord before you leave a bad review on Steam. 🙏

Since the last demo update, we spent the month and a half cooking. There have been plenty of changes and improvements. So we've put them down here. If you're too busy to read them, just see the TLDR bit. Don't forget to scroll to the end to see our roadmap for the next update. 

[h2]⭐Main Highlights (TL;DR)⭐ [/h2]
[b]Update for 0.9.7[/b]
[i]For Public Demo, Build ID: 19382021[/i]

[list]
[*][b]New hotkey system:[/b] (1) Dungeon Codex (2) Spell Journal (3) Spell Torch (4) Healing Wand (5) Talking Skull.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253351/8668767ea5087f58cc1dbb22dc8bd463030ce042.png[/img] 
[*][b]New Emote Wheel UI: [/b]Emotes & dances relocated to [Q] key or Middle‑mouse button
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253351/941405c2727df6ae2e4f995284ac1b699baa4606.png[/img]
[*][b]New Talking animation[/b] now moves head accessories - you can see who’s yapping
[*][b]Traitor Mode enhanced[/b] - 3 new options + Misty Forest map: In response to feedback, there are now options to lock players in place in the voting hall, change win conditions and disable curse words in the voting hall
[*][b]Twitch Integration[/b]: Totems spawn in dungeons - Chat votes on outcomes
[*][b]New Graphics settings:[/b] Lower spec devices can play our game now. (We ran on a Intel N100 and hit 25-40fps on Low settings, 960px x 540px, blurry but playable🙂)
[*][b]Dungeon lighting[/b] made brighter
[*][b]Mouse sensitivity settings[/b] added and Invert Mouse option while Spectating
[*][b]Preloading assets on Game startup[/b] to reduce wait times on joining game sessions
[/list]

[h2]🧩User Experience Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*]Hotkey system makes key items easier to access. You still need to scroll to get to other items or treasure
[*]You can now move while Spell Journal or Dungeon Codex is open
[*]Dungeon opening/closing now requires confirmation popup
[*]Guidebook auto-hides at start; new players see a one-time instruction page
[*][b]Boomer Mine[/b] → now Boomer Bomb (appearance changed, same function): Players thought it functioned like a landmine and avoided going near it. So we changed the appearance and name.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253351/82eca284aad5773ca52058715f784366b7af9068.png[/img]
[*]Whispering Grimoire  → now Loudmouth  (appearance changed, same function): Players thought it was a spell book so they did not realise that the creature sounds were coming out of the object
[*]Lobby codes hidden by default
[*]Settings menu now accessible in the main lobby
[*]Curses and local notification fonts increased for readability
[*]UI visuals streamlined and other tweaks
[/list]

[h2]⚙️Settings[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253351/bb35dcd855cb7f835bba57ab66509abb4c18af67.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Emotes/Dances now on [Q] key or Middle‑mouse via the Emote Wheel UI
[*]Push-to-Talk [b]does not trigger[/b] Curses and Curse Doors anymore (no more cheating!) but still can trigger Equipment and Monsters
[*]Spectator mode now has Invert Mouse option
[*]Adjustable Mouse Sensitivity
[*]Graphics Quality via XESS upscaling - this improves performance on older machines that can support XESS.
[*]Selectable Screen Resolution and Fullscreen/Windowed mode
[*]Auto-reconnect if voice chat drops - check here if you can't hear your teammates or vice versa.
[*]Controls (Keyboard) have been updated 
[/list]

[h2]🔪Traitor Mode Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*]Option to Disable Death and Treasure curses in Voting Hall to stop abuse
[*]Option to freeze players during voting (blocks sabotage with Sacrificial Knife or Boomer Bomb)
[*]Option to allow Companions to win if all Traitors are eliminated (one Companion must survive)
[*]Skip-vote majority now ends meeting immediately
[*]Bug preventing players from leaving Voting Hall fixed
[/list]

[h2]📺 Twitch Integration[/h2]
[list]
[*]Dungeon Totems let Twitch Chat vote on outcomes (see this post - https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3265230/view/537731883551690602)
[*]Requires linking Twitch Creator account in-game
[*]Chat votes via “!number” shown on-screen
[*]If a non-Creator triggers a Totem, results are random
[*]With multiple creators, the first activator should get chat voting authority (we hope)
[*][i]Note: Behavior with shared chat across creators currently unknown[/i]
[/list]

[h2]⚖️ Gameplay Balance[/h2]
[list]
[*]Spell words now rotate every 5 minutes (was 2)
[*]Curse Remover now clears one random curse only (it used to clear all curses)
[*]Trigger range reduced for Root Golem
[*]Meatgrinder damage slightly increased
[*]Healing Wand price raised to 450 Gold
[*]Sacrificial Knife damage reduced; reworded to clarify that maximum value capped at 3
[*]Watcher now applies Poison instead of high raw damage when you enter the green gas
[*]Greedy Goblets slow-down reduced to 30 seconds
[*]Gold value of Body Parts reduced by around 50%
[*]Removed less-responsive curse phrase triggers
[*]Slightly reduced spawn rates for Black Coins and Equipment
[*]New room variations for Dungeon Entrance
[*]Removed: Steam Bath, Teleportaloo, and Dungeon Teleport Circle from Traitor Mode
[*]Dark Shrine options reduced to three: respawn, treasure, or extra time (most players didn't use the other options)
[*]Player names visible from further away when you mouse over their characters
[/list]

[h2]🐞Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed: stuck in Traitor Hall
[*]Resolved: unkillable Chatterboxes and Red Annes (due to network sync)
[*]Partially Fixed (might still occur) : inconsistent dungeon generation across players (when players see a different dungeon from each other)
[*]Now possible to pick up items near dead Players
[*]Added spectate mode portal timer to display time left
[*]Late joiners (Players who join halfway when the game has started) can now spectate curse words properly
[*]Partially fixed (might still occur): falling through map in Dungeon
[*]Fixed various monster pathing/stuck issues
[*]Disabled arrow traps no longer deal damage
[*]Items from previous failed games no longer carry over
[*]Fixed: poison gas animation in Voting Hall (it wasn't visible the last time)
[*]Fixed: revived player in the Traitor mode will have the correct role (Companion or Traitor)
[*]Fixed a bug where players can play past Day 3 in the demo
[*]Fixed a bug where the arrow trap collider still kills players even though the trap is disabled
[/list]

[h2]🧾Other Adjustments[/h2]
[list]
[*]Logo intro volume turned down
[*]Spike trap spikes lowered slightly
[*]Improved background image for Scroll of Praise
[*]Updated designs for Dungeon Codex and Spell Journal to improve legibility
[*]Edited tutorial text for clarity
[*]Multiple Foul Moths no longer overlap each other
[*]New prompt added when playing Traitor Mode first time
[*]Cleaned up the grammar and improved the text descriptions for the Equipment, Treasures, and notifications
[/list]

[h2]🐞Known Bugs[/h2]
[list]
[*] Traitor Mode: If you revive a late joiner via the Dark Shrine, player has no role assigned in the game
[*] Late joiners - if they join a game midway - they are unable to hear other dead players (in spectate mode)
[*] Players can sometimes move when the portal open / close scene plays
[/list]

[h2]🚗Roadmap[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Coming Up in the next Demo: [/b]New languages - French, German, Spanish and Chinese (Simplified)
[*]Working towards Early Access
[*]Steam Achievements
[*]More Twitch integrations
[*]New maps, new monsters, new dungeons, new traps and new game modes (we're keeping this a secret)
[/list]

Thank you for reading and getting all the way to the end, there's gotta be a special achievement for this! Our wishlists are growing and the viewership on Twitch has hit over 71,000 hours watched. 

We've got a date in mind for our launch and it does depend if we can hit our goals for what we want the EA version to be. We'll update you as soon as possible. In the meantime, join our Discord (https://discord.com/invite/WpmWCmgZRz) to give feedback and as always WISHLIST US!

notes.title: Player Tips: How Not to Die Immediately
notes.content:
Thanks to the playtesters and going through hours of their streams, we've seen how different players handle the chaos of [b]Cursed Companions[/b], and some squads are really nailing it… and some, well, let's just say they need to work on their communication skills.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253351/78a01dca859eb8e385aa16b175611abe8837f54f.gif[/img]
If you're new to the game or just looking to improve, here are some survival tips based on our own experiences and from watching playtesters play.

[h3]Start With Your Voice[/h3]
So we're not your typical shooter. Players won't have weapons at the start. But the main tool you have is your voice and at the risk of sounding cliche, your squad! So, starting with your voice:
[list]
[*] Speak your spells clearly (we know it's hard when you're panicking).
[*] Assign someone who can speak clearly, with clear pronunciation to be the [b]Bookkeeper[/b] - they'll read from the spellbooks.
[*] Keep communicating. Keep talking, keep telling others what's going on
[/list]
[h3]Squad Roles That Help You Survive[/h3]
We notice good teams assign roles to their teammates, which is something that we have envisioned all along and it's wonderful to see players naturally doing so, figuring it out as they play. So some roles that you can assign to your teammates are:
[list]
[*] [b]The Torch Bearer[/b]: Walks ahead, warns of monsters, leads the group, familiar with the game. Someone who talks a lot.
[*] [b]The Medic[/b]: Focuses on healing spells - keep everyone alive. Keep spamming those spells!
[*] [b]The Porter[/b]: Hauls treasure and carries loot (give this player the right potions to increase their inventory slots), pair this player with the Wayhome Stone or Teleport Stone
[*] [b]The Bookkeeper[/b]: Reads from the Dungeon Codex and Spell Books.
[/list]
Working in [b]pairs or trios[/b] works best. Going solo? Unless you're Sung Jin-woo, we don't recommend it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253351/692cd99ae13f1ae4a8c21392514d37f9f4da97c4.png[/img]
[h3]Treasure and Loot Strategies[/h3]
[list]
[*] Stash treasures at dungeon exits - it's a time-tested strategy.
[*] Send your fastest player to run them home, either a player with extra speed boost or extra stamina boost
[*] If you hit your treasure goal, don't dump everything into the Treasure Chest! Save the extra Treasures for the next day. You don't get points for exceeding the quotas.
[/list]
[h3]Monster Survival Tips[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Foulmoth[/b]: Keep it G-rated, channel your inner Disney. This monster does its worst when the team gets into a sticky situation and starts to panic and starts cussing!
[*][b]Mannequin[/b]: Communication and teamwork is the key. Once you got that down, she's pretty much nullified. Good luck if you meet her solo (most likely results in your death).
[*][b]Boomer Mine[/b]: This is essential, once this is unlocked in the shop, get it straightaway. It gives you that one chance to get away from the monster and survive longer.
[/list]
Sometimes, patience is key - wait for monsters to pass before pushing forward.

[h3]Late Game Strategy[/h3]
[list]
[*] Use the facilities like the Bath House and items like the Teleport ring to increase your chances of surviving the tough late game.
[*] [b]Teleport Stones[/b] = lifesavers, use them strategically.
[*] [b]Dark Shrine[/b] = load up on the Scroll of Praise, you'll never know when you'll encounter the Dark Shrine, but if you do, it's a free Treasure if you've got the scroll with you.
[/list]
[h3]Teamwork is key[/h3]
If you want to survive, play as a team. It can be easy if you work together. 

We hope those tips help! We're looking at more of your gameplay streams and seeing how you play the game. Maybe there's something out there we've not covered, we hope to see it in your streams! 

Got a clever survival tactic? Come chat with us on [url=https://discord.com/invite/WpmWCmgZRz]Discord[/url] and share with the rest of the community!

And as always - WISHLIST!

tags.feature: We built Traitor Mode because players were already trying to trick each other in Co-op Mode. They were trying to work the curse words into the conversation and killing their teammate for fun. So it became clear we had to build this new mechanic as it added a new dimension of fun. With just a few tweaks, this co-op game turned into a social deduction game. ːsteamhappyː

In this mode, players are split into two roles: [b]Companions[/b] and [b]Traitors[/b]. The game assigns these roles randomly at the start. The game Host sets how many traitors there are and can adjust some other settings.
Traitors can see the curse words of Companions. They can use these to damage teammates by saying or baiting others into saying the wrong word.

Traitors can curse other players by firing a 'Death Curse projectile'. Only the Traitor firing the Death Curse can see the projectile. Other players can't tell who fired it. (Players who receive a death curse will have a Death Curse aura, everyone can see the aura.)
Traitors can even curse themselves to avoid suspicion.
Companions can’t see anyone’s curse words but their own.
Traitors can see who their fellow traitors are but they can't see their curse words
The main goal is to collect Treasure from the Dungeon, same as Co-op Mode, but now you only get 1 day to do it.
Each player can carry up to 4 Treasures (compared to 1 in co-op)

You get one Emergency Meeting per game. Anyone can call it by saying the trigger phrase - "Emergency Meeting". This teleports everyone who's still alive to the Voting Hall, where the group votes on who they think the traitor is.
The player with the most votes is eliminated.
Traitors win if all companions are dead, or if the companions fail to collect the required treasure.
Companions win by reaching the treasure goal before the Day ends.

This mode changes the way you play completely. It adds social deduction to the mechanics. Players start watching what they say, reacting to suspicious behavior, and trying to figure out who’s working against the group. You’ll notice:
Traitors faking mistakes or "slipping up" to appear innocent
Teammates over-explaining or staying quiet to avoid attention (this is a dead giveaway, especially if they are really chatty beforehand)
Accidental "Death cursing" (firing the Death Curse projectile) from panicking or poor timing
It’s a completely different vibe from Co-op Mode and it’s made for people who like to lie, bluff, or catch others in the act.

notes.title: Feature Spotlight: Voice Activation
notes.content:
[h2]Words Have Power - How speech became a game mechanic [/h2]

When we first tested the voice activated mechanic, the idea was simple: you say the spell, and cool stuff happens. But so what, right? It's cool only the first time.

Then while test playing the proof-of-concept prototypes, we realized it was way more fun (and chaotic) when someone else could say it for you. Suddenly, you could rely on your friends to help you out. That teamwork angle really clicked, and it became one of the core pillars of the game.

But then we thought… if words could help, what if they could also harm?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253351/9f320e9b5f402e1978e73497ee831ef6f114e378.png[/img]

That’s how the idea of curse words - literally, words that are cursed - were born. Saying the wrong word can doom your team and adds to the chaos and laughter. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253351/9d3d55425f181955ef497ef5dce27e980281f91a.png[/img]
Then taking this concept of 'taboo' words further, adding an imposter or traitor mode was the next natural step. In traitor mode, the chosen traitor (who can see curse words) can intentionally (and claim it was an accident!) say the wrong words to kill non-traitors and win the game. 

[h2]Writing Spells 101[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253351/181d9a49346d27934219d9a5d5d5b6c28690088b.png[/img]
At first, our spell phrases were super serious, like "Ashes to Ashes" or "Whispers of Ruin". But once we started testing (and messing about), the serious "wizardy" stuff didn't feel right, it was just funnier to say funny words and phrases.

Writing those spells wasn’t as simple as we thought. Under normal conditions, the spells trigger fine but when players panic, they speak faster, with a higher pitch, and mispronounce everything! 

We had to craft spells that were short - around 3 to 4 syllables - and could be said clearly in under two seconds. We rewrote them so often, we ended up making a tool just to test them. We’re now working on releasing that tool to the community so you can make your own spells and share them. More on that soon.

The name Cursed Companions feels more perfect than ever. The pun on the word "Cursed" works so well. "Curse" as in hexed, and "curse" as in speaking foul words.

[h2]New demo coming, stay tuned[/h2]
Thanks for following along - we're still cooking. We have a new demo coming up for Next Fest so stay tuned for more updates. Drop by our [url=https://discord.com/invite/WpmWCmgZRz]Discord channel[/url] and say Hi. 

And as always [b]WISHLIST[/b]!

notes.title: Progress Update: Game Mechanics and UI Improvements
notes.content:
Howdy Companions! Part three of our progress update continues. We're covering topics such as user experience and improvements to the game mechanics.

[h2]UI/UX Improvements[/h2]

[h3]New Menu Screen[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253351/5d2e64c71d040616dd77277c1169f00fff215b9c.png[/img]
In the Demo, most people didn't see our Traitor mode! That's why playtesting is so important (duh)! The new menu screen is designed to be more user-friendly. The two game modes - Co-op and Traitor - are now in a more prominent location.

[h3]Other UI/UX improvements and Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Host Identification:[/b] There was earlier no way to know who the host was, especially if the earlier host disconnected and the host status was transferred to another client.
[*] [b]UI improvements: [/b]We’ve made a few tweaks to the UI to make the game more intuitive. Pressing the Esc buttons will close the UI overlays first (before this, it always brought up the Settings screen). And other small improvements have been made for smoother navigation.
[*] [b]Late Joiner Issues Resolved: [/b] Players who joined games in progress were experiencing syncing issues, which resulted in different gameplay experiences. E.g. Late joiners see open traps when it in actual fact was closed, or vastly different dungeons were generated. We’ve fixed this problem (hopefully).
[/list]

[h2]Tweaks to Game Mechanics[/h2]

[h3]You get a curse! You get a curse! Everyone gets a curse![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253351/5fb925f9dd65e8d006b69bafcecb69b6370b53b2.png[/img]
All players get a Death Curse by default at the start, in the Co-op Mode. Why? The Death Curse mechanics only kicked in when players died and respawned on Day 2, which delayed the introduction of the Death Curse concept. Therefore we decided to give everyone a curse when they start! So the fun/chaos starts earlier too!

[h3]Inventory Tweaks and UI[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253351/6559b313c65dc038efbb179b88a98a4b01146c7b.png[/img]
As you get deeper in the game, you may have upgraded your inventory and treasure carrying capability. And it was obvious that players needed a way to see how much they could carry. Secondly, we increased the item slot by one (now you can carry 5 items). This is also due to the change we made covered by the next point below.

[h3]Loot now includes potions and items[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253351/d93a0ef357268f4c4af43d0598ada7b271888353.png[/img]
Abyssal Lands and Dungeon loot drops includes items such as potions, items, along with the original Adventurer Parts and the Coins. This makes life a little better, especially if you have no Gold left to buy items, you may pick up some life-saving items in the Lands or in the Dungeons. 

Say, you end up deep in the Dungeons, lost and destined for death, and through sheer luck pick up a Teleport Stone and survive! What a story to tell! That's what we want to achieve!

[h3]Other changes to the mechanics:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Gregory spawns on all maps now, previously it was a coin toss, 50/50 chance.
[*] Boomer Mine stuns Monsters (they slow down and attacks deal 0 damage) allowing you to escape
[*] Lurker, Bride, Mandrake, and Mannequin will re-target if they no longer detect you.
[*] Reward for completing each Quest loop (Gold and Black Coins)
[*] Dark Shrine will revive dead players at the Shrine instead of on the Island
[*] Multiple monsters can spawn in the same spawn spot in late stages
[*] Balance tweaks to Traitor mode (Players now can carry more than one Treasure, so Traitors don't always win)
[/list]

[h2]Roadmap[/h2]
[list]
[*] Working on a tool for players to change the phrases: make your own phrases and share with your friends
[*] A new monster who doesn't like people to stare, plus a few more, but we won't ruin the surprise
[*] More Treasures with special abilities
[*] New Dungeon rooms and magic doors
[*] New languages for the spells and phrases
[/list]
 
[h2]Conclusion[/h2]
We're working hard fixing bugs, and watching all the playtests and constantly improving the mechanics and user experience and content! Stay tuned for more updates, and as always, WISHLIST!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3265230/Cursed_Companions/

If you want to get in touch with us, join our Discord, or follow us on Twitter.

Regards,
The Devs at Crimson Forge Studios

notes.title: Progress Update: More Tools to Survive the Deep Dungeons
notes.content:
Hey Companions! Part two of our progress update continues. More items and facilities to help you last into Day 4 and beyond. Especially as the dungeons get deeper, players need more tools and strategies to survive.

[h2]Facilities[/h2]
These structures on the Island help with your overall strategy, whether to heal yourself, teleport to a team mate, teleport to the dungeon, and more.

[h3]Teleportaloo[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253351/831e9bacfab1ddb2f72676d1fa60ecfa99af60ba.png[/img]
It's an outdoor toilet and a teleportation device! A magical outhouse that will teleport you straight to one of your team members. This will come in really handy when equipped with a Teleport or the Wayhome stone, so you can keep making runs back and forth, collecting as much Treasure as you can. Pro-tip, load up on the Queen's Favor potion to carry more Treasure in your inventory!

[i]Note: not a real toilet[/i] 😎

[h3]Bath House[/h3]
Need to heal up? Head over to the Bath House where you can restore your health, remove toxins and other forms of virulent plagues.

[h3]Teleport Ring[/h3]
The Teleport Ring will randomly teleport you to a new location in the dungeon. But be warned you could end up deep in the depths! Make sure you bring along a Teleport Stone or a Wayhome Stone so you can make your way back!

[h3]Status Board[/h3]
With the Status Board, you’ll always know who’s alive and who’s dead. It’s a quick way to check the current game state and track the progress of your companions in real time.

[h3]Beacon Upgrade[/h3]
Say "I can see clearly now" in the Abyssal Lands, it now displays the Dungeon Side Entrances in red and Dark Shrine in purple. This will come in handy in the later stages of the game.

[h2]Items and inventory[/h2]
We're making an improvement to the items. Along with the coins, body parts, items now appear as loot in the Abyssal Lands and the Dungeons. Previously you could only buy it in the Shop, but now there is a chance the torch may drop, or a potion. It makes exploring more rewarding and also helps you survive better. Because of that change, we have also increased the number of items you can carry by default from four to five.

[h3]Boomer Mine[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253351/4357f0082ed12623cc51b599ba8566888c18fe1d.gif[/img]
A new explosive that’s triggered by a word! If you say the right word, the Boomer Mine will go boom, dealing damage to nearby players and stunning anyone who survives the blast. Use it strategically to slow down monsters... or your teammates.

[h3]Curse Remover[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253351/bf9b324adf3ffc2800f57e75293913515d1f5e4e.gif[/img]
Use the Curse Remover to scrub away any Death Curse you have. Useful if you keep stacking up those annoying curses. Expensive though, so you better collect as much gold as you can.

[h3]Cure-All Potion[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253351/32ab03c881d78607d2ff7bb4621b05a7ff47dea8.gif[/img]
These potions are here to restore your health and remove any poisons, blight and more. Super useful! Very handy for advanced levels where monsters are aplenty! Or if you friends talk way too much and trigger your curse words by accident!

[h3]Cleansing Bell[/h3]
Got too many curses? The Cleansing Bell can transfer your curses to other players. Use it strategically to offload your bad luck onto someone else - perfect to cause total chaos!

[h2]New Decor and Furniture[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253351/fb96f90d701c66b4a2e17a26208397d300c51cf3.gif[/img]
Decorate your house with brand new furniture items! From chairs to tables, we’ve got a whole host of new options to help personalize your space.

[h2]Conclusion[/h2]
This is not a comprehensive list of new stuff, there's a lot more we've not revealed. Just a little teaser of things you'd get when we launch the game into Early Access.

We're working to playtest these features so if you're interested, please hop to our [url=https://discord.com/invite/WpmWCmgZRz]Discord[/url] and give us a holler.

We're working hard towards the Early Access release this year, trying to ensure the experience is as great as possible. Stay tuned for more updates, and as always, WISHLIST!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3265230/Cursed_Companions/

Regards,
The Devs at Crimson Forge Studios

The Devs at Crimson Forge Studios

notes.title: Big Update + Steam Next Fest + Imposter Mode
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253351/dbd592a3931a7bd1cd0d729303b934a924430d50.jpg[/img]Hey everyone! We’ve got some exciting news—our game is part of Steam Next Fest! That means you can jump in and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3400570/Cursed_Companions_Demo/]try the demo[/url] right now. If you haven’t yet, this is the perfect time to experience our chaotic, funny, voice-activated horror co-op. On top of that, we’re rolling out a huge update, and the biggest addition is [b]Traitor (or Imposter) Mode[/b].

[h2]Traitor Mode: Can You Trust Your Team? And other new things![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253351/3a22c3fb9de20fe13309051a0aa8c3d2bc2f5dee.png[/img]
Traitor Mode adds a new twist to the game, much like Among Us’ Imposter mode. Players still work together to survive, but now some are secretly working against the team. Traitors are chosen at random and can curse other players or even curse themselves to avoid suspicion. 

The game host can adjust some settings, but the goal stays the same—traitors must stay hidden while sabotaging the group. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253351/33865b42a475475712e81041653dc9b9bfd5c679.png[/img]
Traitors can also see other players' curse words and health, making it easier to slip the wrong words into conversation without getting caught (at least that's the idea, some teammates may be a little paranoid!). Traitors can also work together as they know who's on their side and who isn't.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253351/8a22158aecadadc0549ecb7163090656d739df55.png[/img]
With up to 16 players, the stakes get even higher. If you think someone’s a traitor, call (literally just shout the words) "Emergency Meeting" out loud. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253351/93b6cfc6b3cccfb31d13f1a9c15f5d0f344abc36.png[/img]
Then, in the Voting Hall, players argue their case and vote who they think is the treacherous imposter. Once the player is voted the traitor, they can shout "You Traitor!" to kill them. But if you’re wrong, you might have just helped the real traitor win. 

[h2]OTHER UPDATES[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253351/9eef64cec1f340e638a00bdd448bf5230f5a7147.png[/img]
You can change your outfits now!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253351/746af900709940b2a3383bf8b31f20f0d8d06a4d.png[/img]
We added a new shop called the House Catalog. We've moved all the furniture to that shop, so the main Shop will only contain equipment

[h2]Change Log[/h2]
[list]
[*] Updated the Holy Hand Grenade's spell word
[*] Health Potion, Curse Scrubber added
[*] Traitor Mode added
[*] Decorated the house with a bit more furniture
[*] Teleport Stone brings the player into a random location in the Abyssal Lands (it has been nerfed sorry)
[*] Improved the magic spells words, added some new phrases, removed those phrases that did not work well with playtesters
[*] Made the Home Island prettier
[*] A default Treasure is added to the Home, as a way to introduce players to the concept of Curses.
[*] If you get a Death Curse, an animation plays around the you
[*] Made improvements and tweaks to game balance
[*] We're in Beta!
[/list]

[h2]Roadmap[/h2]
[list]
[*] You may encounter a Totem chamber in the Demo. It currently gives you random item or a curse. We're currently working on Twitch integration for streamers to run Polls on their chats.
[*] Fixing more bugs
[*] Adding more monsters
[*] Adding special rooms
[*] Thanks to our wonderful playtesters (you know who you are) we found out why players fall off the map at the doors to the dungeons
[/list]

Give the demo a shot, let us know what you think, and get ready for [b]more madness[/b] as we continue refining and expanding the game. Thanks for all the support—we can’t wait to hear what you think!

notes.title: Major update for Cursed Companions (Alpha 0.8.2)
notes.content:
Thanks to the wonderful feedback from our players, we’ve implemented a host of improvements to the game! Your input is invaluable, and we’re so grateful to have such an engaged community helping us refine and enhance the experience. Here’s a closer look at some of the major updates:

[h2]Major updates:[/h2]

[h3]Redefining the Companions[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253351/2be472c828dd9fb94d7bf1f2ce0afce76488e314.jpg[/img]
Many of you shared mixed feelings about the previous look of our Companions, and you were absolutely right—they didn’t quite hit the mark. We went back to the drawing board and gave them a new look: now they’re little red imps with horns and goggles, exuding a cheeky charm. We think this design is much more cohesive and fits the game’s vibe. It's a better 'face' for the game. Definitely a huge improvement. More on this topic in our previous [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/3265230/announcements/detail/6467826493922738369]post[/url].

[h3]Dynamic Monster Spawns[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253351/fef89d9eeffaa7f4df76f01a7343893a39c1f89f.png[/img]
Monsters no longer spawn immediately when a portal opens. Instead, their spawn times are now randomized and delayed, creating more unpredictable encounters. This means you’ll need to stay on your toes, even when heading back home in the Abyssal Lands or retracing your steps back to the Dungeon entrance.

[h3]Improvements to the User Interface[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253351/8a29fab1336301c22b2ec40d5ad28824c7a9b1d4.png[/img]
We’ve overhauled the UI to provide more help and instructions. Many players didn't read the instructions at the start so instead of overwhelming you with information upfront, we now introduce tips and tutorials gradually as you explore new zones. This should make onboarding smoother (hopefully). You can also find your way to the dungeon entrance and back home now via a beacon which can be triggered using the magic words.

[h3]Public Game Hosting[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253351/274ce28a4bac91fab4d5da0b97c3d76a57e7dd5b.png[/img]
You can now host public game sessions, making it easier to connect with other players. Want to team up with strangers or build a community? Now you can! Plus, if someone isn’t following the rules or is being disruptive, you can easily kick them out.

[h3]Randomized Portal Spawn Points[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253351/4112edafafe8546d78af6ff09154867dea714066.png[/img]
To help new players find their way, portal spawn points now appear closer to the castle during the early stages of the game. The maps remain vast, but this tweak makes navigation more intuitive and reduces early-stage frustration.

[h3]New Island Wing with Training Grounds[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253351/b44a61ef587667979579262b4e85b33789e2043d.png[/img]
We’ve added a new wing to the Island that serves as a training ground for new players. This area features floor and arrow traps where you can safely practice your voice commands and strategies before diving into the dungeon. It’s a great place to hone your skills and build confidence.

[h3]Push-to-Talk for Streamers[/h3]
Dear streamers, Push-to-Talk is now available, allowing you to communicate with your audience without being overheard by your teammates. Keep in mind, though, that the game is always listening to what you say, that includes monsters, curse words, magic spells, etc.

[h3]Expanded Inventory Slots[/h3]
We’ve increased inventory slots by one, giving you more flexibility to carry items, potions, and other essentials. This small change opens up new strategies and makes inventory management a bit less restrictive.

[h3]New Gestures and Dances for Emotes[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253351/bd9fd6dbb668fd1821b2f86d81091bee6e95388b.png[/img]
We’ve added 8 new gestures (sit, thumbs up, thumbs down, taunt, salute, surrender, facepalm, L for loser) to give you more ways to express yourself in-game. We've also added a few more dance moves too. 

[h3]Furniture Customization[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253351/985e35134c70683b7aec1fad077fe60204b8f28e.png[/img]
You can now buy furniture and move it around the Island to decorate your home. This feature adds a personal touch to your space. Future iterations will include functional furniture that enhances gameplay—stay tuned!

[h3]Monster Guide[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253351/988d3d2ef4d806fdeb1cf9c07dd59e539aa5d9f4.png[/img]
We’ve added a Monster Guide to the in-game guidebook. This feature provides tips and strategies for dealing with creatures. You can only unlock details about a monster after it has killed you. Learn from your defeats and come back stronger!

[h2]Other updates[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added noise cancellation threshold slider
[*] Celebration when the game is successfully completed
[*] Reduce Death Curse damage to 10
[*] Improved pick up distance for objects
[*] Increased door opening UI trigger distance
[*] Added beacons which can be triggered with magic words, to guide your way to the main entrance and side entrance
[*] Added spike traps and poison traps in the Dungeon
[*] Added ability to restart the game at the Game Over screen with the same players
[*] Added a global notification when the warning bell tolls
[*] Made more items available at the Shop at the start
[*] Removed the intro video
[*] Notification shown to the person who killed team mate with the cursed word
[*] Showing ping value in the settings for debugging lag
[*] Brightness bar reduced to 0.4 from 1.0 ːsteammockingː
[*] improvements made to animation and other visuals
[*] Changes made to the Mandrake's behavior (smaller listening range, less easy to trigger)
[*] Improved phrases for the magic words, curse words
[*] Fix bug for the voice activation circle for the traps (previously if two or more players were standing on the trap, it does not trigger the trap)
[*] Added a Healing Wand
[*] Fix bugs for Teleport Stone and Portal Clock
[*] FoulMoth triggers a local notification when it is attached to the player.
[/list]

These updates aim to enhance both the core gameplay and the overall player experience. We’re constantly striving to make the game better and more enjoyable, so keep the feedback coming. Your insights truly make a difference. ːsteamthumbsupː

Thank you again for being part of this journey—we couldn’t do it without you!

notes.title: Be the pioneers of the Cursed Companions
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, Cursed Companions![/h2]

We’re thrilled to announce that the first public playtest of Cursed Companions is live! Everyone is invited to join and explore the Abyssal Lands and Dungeons. Your [url=https://forms.gle/j7DGBgyTzo2CVnfi6]feedback[/url] is vital to making Cursed Companions the best experience possible, so dive in, have fun, and please let us know your thoughts!

[h2]Hosting a Playtest[/h2]
[list]
[*] Cursed Companions can be played solo, but is best with friends. Many game mechanics require friends to activate. 
[*] There are currently no public servers, so you’ll need to create and host a game for others to join.
[*] Bring along your own friends or find fellow adventurers in our [url=https://discord.gg/WpmWCmgZRz]Discord[/url] server where players are eager to team up!
[/list]

[h2]Hardware[/h2]
As we are using proximity chat and voice-recognition, we highly recommend you play with a microphone headset. 

[h2]Gameplay Overview[/h2]
Here's a quick list of things to look out for when testing:
[list]
[*] Check out our feedback form [url=https://forms.gle/j7DGBgyTzo2CVnfi6]here[/url]. It will give you a good frame of reference.
[*] Test Our Speech Recognition: Cursed Companions features a unique magic system where you speak words to disable traps and activate items. Try it out and let us know how it feels!
[*] Abyssal Lands Spawn Points: Your starting location will be slightly randomized each playthrough, adding a new twist each time.
[*] Procedurally Generated Dungeons: Each dungeon layout is unique! If you encounter a bug, hit ESC, and you’ll find the game seed in the settings page—send that to us along with your feedback.
[*] Meet Gregory: Our newest “friendly” merchant! Gregory’s got potions that might be useful for your journey, so be sure to pay him a visit.
[*] The playtest ends on the [b]third in-game day[/b] if you meet the Queen's treasure target.
[/list]

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45253351/12f445096e2bcddd264deb1acf21a15ac7850f89.png[/img]
[i]Gregory the Merchant will 'aid' you in your quests with a selection of potions and magical ornaments[/i]

[h2]Known Issues & Bug Reporting[/h2]
A list of known bugs is pinned in our [url=https://discord.gg/WpmWCmgZRz]Discord[/url] server. Jump in to report any new issues you encounter, and to chat directly with the devs!

[h2]❤️ Wishlisting & Creator Access[/h2]
Remember to [b]wishlist[/b] us on Steam! It really helps with visibility and keeps you updated on all things Cursed Companions.

If you’re a Streamer or Content Creator, DM us here on Steam for early access—we’d love to see your adventures in the Abyssal Lands!

[b]Launch Date: Targeting Q1 2025—stay tuned![/b]

Thanks to everyone who participated in this first open playtest. Your feedback and enthusiasm mean the world to us. We can’t wait to see how you fare in the Queen’s treacherous dungeon!

Happy exploring, Companions!

⭐P.S. Did we mention this already? Remember to WISHLIST us! ⭐
